units.leftText: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?
units.rightText: He humbles Himself to behold

units.leftText: He raises up the poor out of the dust,
units.rightText: He raises the poor from the dust

units.leftText: that he may set him with princes,
units.rightText: to seat them with nobles,

units.leftText: He settles the barren woman in her home
units.rightText: He settles the barren woman in her home

units.leftText: When Israel went out of Egypt,
units.rightText: When Israel departed from Egypt,

units.leftText: Judah became his sanctuary,
units.rightText: Judah became God’s sanctuary,

units.leftText: The sea saw it, and fled.
units.rightText: The sea observed and fled;

units.leftText: The mountains skipped like rams,
units.rightText: the mountains skipped like rams,

units.leftText: What was it, you sea, that you fled?
units.rightText: Why was it, O sea, that you fled,

units.leftText: You mountains, that you skipped like rams?
units.rightText: O mountains, that you skipped like rams,

units.leftText: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord,
units.rightText: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord,

units.leftText: who turned the rock into a pool of water,
units.rightText: who turned the rock into a pool,

units.leftText: Not to us, LORD, not to us,
units.rightText: Not to us, O LORD, not to us,
leftNotes: 115:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Why should the nations say,
units.rightText: Why should the nations say,

units.leftText: But our God is in the heavens.
units.rightText: Our God is in heaven;

units.leftText: Their idols are silver and gold,
units.rightText: Their idols are silver and gold,

units.leftText: They have mouths, but they don’t speak.
units.rightText: They have mouths, but cannot speak;

units.leftText: They have ears, but they don’t hear.
units.rightText: they have ears, but cannot hear;

units.leftText: They have hands, but they don’t feel.
units.rightText: they have hands, but cannot feel;

units.leftText: Those who make them will be like them;
units.rightText: Those who make them become like them,

units.leftText: Israel, trust in the LORD!
units.rightText: O Israel, trust in the LORD!
rightNotes: 115:9 MT; many Hebrew manuscripts, LXX, and Syriac O house of Israel

units.leftText: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD!
units.rightText: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD!

units.leftText: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD!
units.rightText: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD!

units.leftText: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us.
units.rightText: The LORD is mindful of us;

units.leftText: He will bless those who fear the LORD,
units.rightText: He will bless those who fear the LORD—

units.leftText: May the LORD increase you more and more,
units.rightText: May the LORD give you increase,

units.leftText: Blessed are you by the LORD,
units.rightText: May you be blessed by the LORD,

units.leftText: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens,
units.rightText: The highest heavens belong to the LORD,

units.leftText: The dead don’t praise the LORD,
units.rightText: It is not the dead who praise the LORD,
leftNotes: 115:17 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: but we will bless the LORD,
units.rightText: But it is we who will bless the LORD,
leftNotes: 115:18 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice,
units.rightText: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice —
leftNotes: 116:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Because he has turned his ear to me,
units.rightText: Because He has inclined His ear to me,

units.leftText: The cords of death surrounded me,
units.rightText: The ropes of death entangled me;

units.leftText: Then I called on the LORD’s name:
units.rightText: Then I called on the name of the LORD:

units.leftText: The LORD is gracious and righteous.
units.rightText: The LORD is gracious and righteous;

units.leftText: The LORD preserves the simple.
units.rightText: The LORD preserves the simplehearted;

units.leftText: Return to your rest, my soul,
units.rightText: Return to your rest, O my soul,

units.leftText: For you have delivered my soul from death,
units.rightText: For You have delivered my soul from death,

units.leftText: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
units.rightText: I will walk before the LORD

units.leftText: I believed, therefore I said,
units.rightText: I believed, therefore I said,
rightNotes: 116:10 LXX therefore I have spoken; cited in 2 Corinthians 4:13|2CO 4:13*

units.leftText: I said in my haste,
units.rightText: In my alarm I said,

units.leftText: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
units.rightText: How can I repay the LORD

units.leftText: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.
units.rightText: I will lift the cup of salvation

units.leftText: I will pay my vows to the LORD,
units.rightText: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD

units.leftText: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
units.rightText: Precious in the sight of the LORD

units.leftText: LORD, truly I am your servant.
units.rightText: Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant;

units.leftText: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving,
units.rightText: I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving

units.leftText: I will pay my vows to the LORD,
units.rightText: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD

units.leftText: in the courts of the LORD’s house,
units.rightText: in the courts of the LORD’s house,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, all you nations!
units.rightText: Praise the LORD, all you nations!
leftNotes: 117:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: For his loving kindness is great toward us.
units.rightText: For great is His loving devotion toward us,

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good,
units.rightText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good;
leftNotes: 118:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Let Israel now say
units.rightText: Let Israel say,
rightNotes: 118:2 LXX the house of Israel

units.leftText: Let the house of Aaron now say
units.rightText: Let the house of Aaron say,

units.leftText: Now let those who fear the LORD say
units.rightText: Let those who fear the LORD say,

units.leftText: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD.
units.rightText: In my distress I called to the LORD,
leftNotes: 118:5 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid.
units.rightText: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid.
rightNotes: 118:6 Or The LORD is with me; also in verse 7; LXX The Lord is my helper

units.leftText: The LORD is on my side among those who help me.
units.rightText: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper.

units.leftText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD,
units.rightText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD

units.leftText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD,
units.rightText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD

units.leftText: All the nations surrounded me,
units.rightText: All the nations surrounded me,

units.leftText: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me.
units.rightText: They surrounded me on every side,

units.leftText: They surrounded me like bees.
units.rightText: They swarmed around me like bees,

units.leftText: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall,
units.rightText: I was pushed so hard I was falling,

units.leftText: The LORD is my strength and song.
units.rightText: The LORD is my strength and my song,
leftNotes: 118:14 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous.
units.rightText: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous:

units.leftText: The right hand of the LORD is exalted!
units.rightText: The right hand of the LORD is exalted!

units.leftText: I will not die, but live,
units.rightText: I will not die, but I will live

units.leftText: The LORD has punished me severely,
units.rightText: The LORD disciplined me severely,
leftNotes: 118:18 Hebrew: יה Yah

units.leftText: Open to me the gates of righteousness.
units.rightText: Open to me the gates of righteousness,

units.leftText: This is the gate of the LORD;
units.rightText: This is the gate of the LORD;

units.leftText: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me,
units.rightText: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me,

units.leftText: The stone which the builders rejected
units.rightText: The stone the builders rejected

units.leftText: This is the LORD’s doing.
units.rightText: This is from the LORD,

units.leftText: This is the day that the LORD has made.
units.rightText: This is the day that the LORD has made;

units.leftText: Save us now, we beg you, LORD!
units.rightText: O LORD, save us, we pray.
rightNotes: 118:25 Hebrew hosia-na, meaning save, we pray or save now; see Matthew 21:9|MAT 21:9*, Matthew 21:15, Mark 11:9, and John 12:13.

units.leftText: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name!
units.rightText: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD.
rightNotes: 118:26 Cited in Matthew 21:9|MAT 21:9*, Matthew 23:39, Mark 11:9, Luke 13:35, Luke 19:38, and John 12:13

units.leftText: The LORD is God, and he has given us light.
units.rightText: The LORD is God;

units.leftText: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you.
units.rightText: You are my God, and I will give You thanks.

units.leftText: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good,
units.rightText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good;

units.leftText: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless,
units.rightText: Blessed are those whose way is blameless,
rightNotes: 119:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem of twenty-two stanzas, following the letters of the Hebrew alphabet; within a stanza, each verse begins with the same Hebrew letter.

units.leftText: Blessed are those who keep his statutes,
units.rightText: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies

units.leftText: Yes, they do nothing wrong.
units.rightText: They do no iniquity;

units.leftText: You have commanded your precepts,
units.rightText: You have ordained Your precepts,

units.leftText: Oh that my ways were steadfast
units.rightText: Oh, that my ways were committed

units.leftText: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed,
units.rightText: Then I would not be ashamed

units.leftText: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart,
units.rightText: I will praise You with an upright heart

units.leftText: I will observe your statutes.
units.rightText: I will keep Your statutes;

units.leftText: How can a young man keep his way pure?
units.rightText: How can a young man keep his way pure?

units.leftText: With my whole heart I have sought you.
units.rightText: With all my heart I have sought You;

units.leftText: I have hidden your word in my heart,
units.rightText: I have hidden Your word in my heart

units.leftText: Blessed are you, LORD.
units.rightText: Blessed are You, O LORD;

units.leftText: With my lips,
units.rightText: With my lips I proclaim

units.leftText: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies,
units.rightText: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies

units.leftText: I will meditate on your precepts,
units.rightText: I will meditate on Your precepts

units.leftText: I will delight myself in your statutes.
units.rightText: I will delight in Your statutes;

units.leftText: Do good to your servant.
units.rightText: Deal bountifully with Your servant,

units.leftText: Open my eyes,
units.rightText: Open my eyes that I may see

units.leftText: I am a stranger on the earth.
units.rightText: I am a stranger on the earth;

units.leftText: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
units.rightText: My soul is consumed with longing

units.leftText: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed,
units.rightText: You rebuke the arrogant —

units.leftText: Take reproach and contempt away from me,
units.rightText: Remove my scorn and contempt,

units.leftText: Though princes sit and slander me,
units.rightText: Though rulers sit and slander me,

units.leftText: Indeed your statutes are my delight,
units.rightText: Your testimonies are indeed my delight;

units.leftText: My soul is laid low in the dust.
units.rightText: My soul cleaves to the dust;

units.leftText: I declared my ways, and you answered me.
units.rightText: I recounted my ways, and You answered me;

units.leftText: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts!
units.rightText: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts;

units.leftText: My soul is weary with sorrow;
units.rightText: My soul melts with sorrow;

units.leftText: Keep me from the way of deceit.
units.rightText: Remove me from the path of deceit

units.leftText: I have chosen the way of truth.
units.rightText: I have chosen the way of truth;

units.leftText: I cling to your statutes, LORD.
units.rightText: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD;

units.leftText: I run in the path of your commandments,
units.rightText: I run in the path of Your commandments,

units.leftText: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes.
units.rightText: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes,

units.leftText: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law.
units.rightText: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law,

units.leftText: Direct me in the path of your commandments,
units.rightText: Direct me in the path of Your commandments,

units.leftText: Turn my heart toward your statutes,
units.rightText: Turn my heart to Your testimonies

units.leftText: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things.
units.rightText: Turn my eyes away from worthless things;

units.leftText: Fulfill your promise to your servant,
units.rightText: Establish Your word to Your servant,

units.leftText: Take away my disgrace that I dread,
units.rightText: Turn away the disgrace I dread,

units.leftText: Behold, I long for your precepts!
units.rightText: How I long for Your precepts!

units.leftText: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD,
units.rightText: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD,

units.leftText: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me,
units.rightText: Then I can answer him who taunts,

units.leftText: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth,
units.rightText: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth,

units.leftText: So I will obey your law continually,
units.rightText: I will always obey Your law,

units.leftText: I will walk in liberty,
units.rightText: And I will walk in freedom,

units.leftText: I will also speak of your statutes before kings,
units.rightText: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings,

units.leftText: I will delight myself in your commandments,
units.rightText: I delight in Your commandments

units.leftText: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love.
units.rightText: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love,

units.leftText: Remember your word to your servant,
units.rightText: Remember Your word to Your servant,

units.leftText: This is my comfort in my affliction,
units.rightText: This is my comfort in affliction,

units.leftText: The arrogant mock me excessively,
units.rightText: The arrogant utterly deride me,

units.leftText: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD,
units.rightText: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD,

units.leftText: Indignation has taken hold on me,
units.rightText: Rage has taken hold of me

units.leftText: Your statutes have been my songs
units.rightText: Your statutes are songs to me

units.leftText: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night,
units.rightText: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name,

units.leftText: This is my way,
units.rightText: This is my practice,

units.leftText: The LORD is my portion.
units.rightText: The LORD is my portion;

units.leftText: I sought your favor with my whole heart.
units.rightText: I have sought Your face with all my heart;

units.leftText: I considered my ways,
units.rightText: I considered my ways

units.leftText: I will hurry, and not delay,
units.rightText: I hurried without hesitating

units.leftText: The ropes of the wicked bind me,
units.rightText: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me,

units.leftText: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you,
units.rightText: At midnight I rise to give You thanks

units.leftText: I am a friend of all those who fear you,
units.rightText: I am a friend to all who fear You,

units.leftText: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD.
units.rightText: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD;

units.leftText: You have treated your servant well,
units.rightText: You are good to Your servant, O LORD,

units.leftText: Teach me good judgment and knowledge,
units.rightText: Teach me good judgment and knowledge,

units.leftText: Before I was afflicted, I went astray;
units.rightText: Before I was afflicted, I went astray;

units.leftText: You are good, and do good.
units.rightText: You are good, and You do what is good;

units.leftText: The proud have smeared a lie upon me.
units.rightText: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies,

units.leftText: Their heart is as callous as the fat,
units.rightText: Their hearts are callous and insensitive,
rightNotes: 119:70 Or fat

units.leftText: It is good for me that I have been afflicted,
units.rightText: It was good for me to be afflicted,

units.leftText: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
units.rightText: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me

units.leftText: Your hands have made me and formed me.
units.rightText: Your hands have made me and fashioned me;

units.leftText: Those who fear you will see me and be glad,
units.rightText: May those who fear You see me and rejoice,

units.leftText: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous,
units.rightText: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous,

units.leftText: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort,
units.rightText: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray,

units.leftText: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live;
units.rightText: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live,

units.leftText: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully.
units.rightText: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie;

units.leftText: Let those who fear you turn to me.
units.rightText: May those who fear You turn to me,

units.leftText: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees,
units.rightText: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes,

units.leftText: My soul faints for your salvation.
units.rightText: My soul faints for Your salvation;

units.leftText: My eyes fail for your word.
units.rightText: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise;

units.leftText: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke.
units.rightText: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke,

units.leftText: How many are the days of your servant?
units.rightText: How many days must Your servant wait?
rightNotes: 119:84 Or How many are the days of Your servant?

units.leftText: The proud have dug pits for me,
units.rightText: The arrogant have dug pits for me

units.leftText: All of your commandments are faithful.
units.rightText: All Your commandments are faithful;

units.leftText: They had almost wiped me from the earth,
units.rightText: They almost wiped me from the earth,

units.leftText: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness,
units.rightText: Revive me according to Your loving devotion,

units.leftText: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.
units.rightText: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting;

units.leftText: Your faithfulness is to all generations.
units.rightText: Your faithfulness continues through all generations;

units.leftText: Your laws remain to this day,
units.rightText: Your ordinances stand to this day,
rightNotes: 119:91 Or They stand this day according to Your ordinances

units.leftText: Unless your law had been my delight,
units.rightText: If Your law had not been my delight,

units.leftText: I will never forget your precepts,
units.rightText: I will never forget Your precepts,

units.leftText: I am yours.
units.rightText: I am Yours; save me,

units.leftText: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me.
units.rightText: The wicked wait to destroy me,

units.leftText: I have seen a limit to all perfection,
units.rightText: I have seen a limit to all perfection,

units.leftText: How I love your law!
units.rightText: Oh, how I love Your law!

units.leftText: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies,
units.rightText: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies,

units.leftText: I have more understanding than all my teachers,
units.rightText: I have more insight than all my teachers,

units.leftText: I understand more than the aged,
units.rightText: I discern more than the elders,

units.leftText: I have kept my feet from every evil way,
units.rightText: I have kept my feet from every evil path,

units.leftText: I have not turned away from your ordinances,
units.rightText: I have not departed from Your ordinances,

units.leftText: How sweet are your promises to my taste,
units.rightText: How sweet are Your words to my taste—

units.leftText: Through your precepts, I get understanding;
units.rightText: I gain understanding from Your precepts;

units.leftText: Your word is a lamp to my feet,
units.rightText: Your word is a lamp to my feet

units.leftText: I have sworn, and have confirmed it,
units.rightText: I have sworn and confirmed

units.leftText: I am afflicted very much.
units.rightText: I am severely afflicted, O LORD;

units.leftText: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth.
units.rightText: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD,

units.leftText: My soul is continually in my hand,
units.rightText: I constantly take my life in my hands,

units.leftText: The wicked have laid a snare for me,
units.rightText: The wicked have set a snare for me,

units.leftText: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever,
units.rightText: Your testimonies are my heritage forever,

units.leftText: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever,
units.rightText: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes,

units.leftText: I hate double-minded men,
units.rightText: The double-minded I despise,

units.leftText: You are my hiding place and my shield.
units.rightText: You are my hiding place and my shield;

units.leftText: Depart from me, you evildoers,
units.rightText: Depart from me, you evildoers,

units.leftText: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live.
units.rightText: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live;

units.leftText: Hold me up, and I will be safe,
units.rightText: Uphold me, and I will be saved,

units.leftText: You reject all those who stray from your statutes,
units.rightText: You reject all who stray from Your statutes,

units.leftText: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross.
units.rightText: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross;

units.leftText: My flesh trembles for fear of you.
units.rightText: My flesh trembles in awe of You;

units.leftText: I have done what is just and righteous.
units.rightText: I have done what is just and right;

units.leftText: Ensure your servant’s well-being.
units.rightText: Ensure Your servant’s well-being;

units.leftText: My eyes fail looking for your salvation,
units.rightText: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation,

units.leftText: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness.
units.rightText: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion,

units.leftText: I am your servant. Give me understanding,
units.rightText: I am Your servant; give me understanding,

units.leftText: It is time to act, LORD,
units.rightText: It is time for the LORD to act,

units.leftText: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold,
units.rightText: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold,

units.leftText: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right.
units.rightText: Therefore I admire all Your precepts

units.leftText: Your testimonies are wonderful,
units.rightText: Wonderful are Your testimonies;

units.leftText: The entrance of your words gives light.
units.rightText: The unfolding of Your words gives light;

units.leftText: I opened my mouth wide and panted,
units.rightText: I open my mouth and pant,

units.leftText: Turn to me, and have mercy on me,
units.rightText: Turn to me and show me mercy,

units.leftText: Establish my footsteps in your word.
units.rightText: Order my steps in Your word;

units.leftText: Redeem me from the oppression of man,
units.rightText: Redeem me from the oppression of man,

units.leftText: Make your face shine on your servant.
units.rightText: Make Your face shine upon Your servant,

units.leftText: Streams of tears run down my eyes,
units.rightText: My eyes shed streams of tears

units.leftText: You are righteous, LORD.
units.rightText: Righteous are You, O LORD,

units.leftText: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness.
units.rightText: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous

units.leftText: My zeal wears me out,
units.rightText: My zeal has consumed me

units.leftText: Your promises have been thoroughly tested,
units.rightText: Your promise is completely pure;

units.leftText: I am small and despised.
units.rightText: I am lowly and despised,

units.leftText: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness.
units.rightText: Your righteousness is everlasting

units.leftText: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me.
units.rightText: Trouble and distress have found me,

units.leftText: Your testimonies are righteous forever.
units.rightText: Your testimonies are righteous forever.

units.leftText: I have called with my whole heart.
units.rightText: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD!

units.leftText: I have called to you. Save me!
units.rightText: I call to You; save me,

units.leftText: I rise before dawn and cry for help.
units.rightText: I rise before dawn and cry for help;

units.leftText: My eyes stay open through the night watches,
units.rightText: My eyes anticipate the watches of night,

units.leftText: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness.
units.rightText: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion;

units.leftText: They draw near who follow after wickedness.
units.rightText: Those who follow after wickedness draw near;

units.leftText: You are near, LORD.
units.rightText: You are near, O LORD,

units.leftText: Of old I have known from your testimonies,
units.rightText: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies

units.leftText: Consider my affliction, and deliver me,
units.rightText: Look upon my affliction and rescue me,

units.leftText: Plead my cause, and redeem me!
units.rightText: Defend my cause and redeem me;

units.leftText: Salvation is far from the wicked,
units.rightText: Salvation is far from the wicked

units.leftText: Great are your tender mercies, LORD.
units.rightText: Great are Your mercies, O LORD;

units.leftText: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries.
units.rightText: Though my persecutors and foes are many,

units.leftText: I look at the faithless with loathing,

units.leftText: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning,
units.rightText: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning,

units.leftText: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies.
units.rightText: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD;

units.leftText: Teach me to do your will,
units.rightText: Teach me to do Your will,

units.leftText: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake.
units.rightText: For the sake of Your name, O LORD,

units.leftText: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies,
units.rightText: And in Your loving devotion,

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, my rock,
units.rightText: Of David.

units.leftText: my loving kindness, my fortress,
units.rightText: He is my steadfast love and my fortress,

units.leftText: LORD, what is man, that you care for him?
units.rightText: O LORD, what is man, that You regard him,

units.leftText: Man is like a breath.
units.rightText: Man is like a breath;

units.leftText: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down.
units.rightText: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down;

units.leftText: Throw out lightning, and scatter them.
units.rightText: Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them;

units.leftText: Stretch out your hand from above,
units.rightText: Reach down from on high;

units.leftText: whose mouths speak deceit,
units.rightText: whose mouths speak falsehood,

units.leftText: I will sing a new song to you, God.
units.rightText: I will sing to You a new song, O God;

units.leftText: You are he who gives salvation to kings,
units.rightText: to Him who gives victory to kings,

units.leftText: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners,
units.rightText: Set me free and rescue me

units.leftText: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants,
units.rightText: Then our sons will be like plants

units.leftText: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision.
units.rightText: Our storehouses will be full,

units.leftText: Our oxen will pull heavy loads.
units.rightText: Our oxen will bear great loads.
rightNotes: 144:14 Or Our chieftains will be firmly established

units.leftText: Happy are the people who are in such a situation.
units.rightText: Blessed are the people of whom this is so;

units.leftText: I will exalt you, my God, the King.
units.rightText: A Psalm of praise. Of David.
rightNotes: 145:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem, each verse beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: Every day I will praise you.
units.rightText: Every day I will bless You,

units.leftText: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised!
units.rightText: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised;

units.leftText: One generation will commend your works to another,
units.rightText: One generation will commend Your works to the next,

units.leftText: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor,
units.rightText: the glorious splendor of Your majesty.

units.leftText: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts.
units.rightText: They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds,

units.leftText: They will utter the memory of your great goodness,
units.rightText: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness

units.leftText: The LORD is gracious, merciful,
units.rightText: The LORD is gracious and compassionate,

units.leftText: The LORD is good to all.
units.rightText: The LORD is good to all;

units.leftText: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD.
units.rightText: All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD,

units.leftText: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom,
units.rightText: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom

units.leftText: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts,
units.rightText: to make known to men Your mighty acts

units.leftText: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom.
units.rightText: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom,

units.leftText: The LORD upholds all who fall,
units.rightText: The LORD upholds all who fall

units.leftText: The eyes of all wait for you.
units.rightText: The eyes of all look to You,

units.leftText: You open your hand,
units.rightText: You open Your hand

units.leftText: The LORD is righteous in all his ways,
units.rightText: The LORD is righteous in all His ways

units.leftText: The LORD is near to all those who call on him,
units.rightText: The LORD is near to all who call on Him,

units.leftText: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him.
units.rightText: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him;

units.leftText: The LORD preserves all those who love him,
units.rightText: The LORD preserves all who love Him,

units.leftText: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD.
units.rightText: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD;

units.leftText: Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 146:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
rightNotes: 146:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 10

units.leftText: While I live, I will praise the LORD.
units.rightText: I will praise the LORD all my life;

units.leftText: Don’t put your trust in princes,
units.rightText: Put not your trust in princes,

units.leftText: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth.
units.rightText: When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground;

units.leftText: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help,
units.rightText: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob,

units.leftText: who made heaven and earth,
units.rightText: the Maker of heaven and earth,

units.leftText: who executes justice for the oppressed;
units.rightText: He executes justice for the oppressed

units.leftText: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind.
units.rightText: the LORD opens the eyes of the blind,

units.leftText: The LORD preserves the foreigners.
units.rightText: The LORD protects foreigners;

units.leftText: The LORD will reign forever;
units.rightText: The LORD reigns forever,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD,
units.rightText: Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 147:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
rightNotes: 147:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 20

units.leftText: The LORD builds up Jerusalem.
units.rightText: The LORD builds up Jerusalem;
leftNotes: 147:2 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: He heals the broken in heart,
units.rightText: He heals the brokenhearted

units.leftText: He counts the number of the stars.
units.rightText: He determines the number of the stars;

units.leftText: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power.
units.rightText: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power;

units.leftText: The LORD upholds the humble.
units.rightText: The LORD sustains the humble,

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving.
units.rightText: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving;

units.leftText: who covers the sky with clouds,
units.rightText: who covers the sky with clouds,

units.leftText: He provides food for the livestock,
units.rightText: He provides food for the animals,

units.leftText: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse.
units.rightText: He does not delight in the strength of the horse;

units.leftText: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him,
units.rightText: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem!
units.rightText: Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem;

units.leftText: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates.
units.rightText: For He strengthens the bars of your gates

units.leftText: He makes peace in your borders.
units.rightText: He makes peace at your borders;

units.leftText: He sends out his commandment to the earth.
units.rightText: He sends forth His command to the earth;

units.leftText: He gives snow like wool,
units.rightText: He spreads the snow like wool;

units.leftText: He hurls down his hail like pebbles.
units.rightText: He casts forth His hail like pebbles.
rightNotes: 147:17 Or like crumbs or like morsels

units.leftText: He sends out his word, and melts them.
units.rightText: He sends forth His word and melts them;

units.leftText: He shows his word to Jacob,
units.rightText: He declares His word to Jacob,

units.leftText: He has not done this for just any nation.
units.rightText: He has done this for no other nation;

units.leftText: Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 148:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
rightNotes: 148:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 14

units.leftText: Praise him, all his angels!
units.rightText: Praise Him, all His angels;

units.leftText: Praise him, sun and moon!
units.rightText: Praise Him, O sun and moon;

units.leftText: Praise him, you heavens of heavens,
units.rightText: Praise Him, O highest heavens,

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD’s name,
units.rightText: Let them praise the name of the LORD,

units.leftText: He has also established them forever and ever.
units.rightText: He established them forever and ever;

units.leftText: Praise the LORD from the earth,
units.rightText: Praise the LORD from the earth,

units.leftText: lightning and hail, snow and clouds,
units.rightText: lightning and hail, snow and clouds,

units.leftText: mountains and all hills,
units.rightText: mountains and all hills,

units.leftText: wild animals and all livestock,
units.rightText: wild animals and all cattle,

units.leftText: kings of the earth and all peoples,
units.rightText: kings of the earth and all peoples,

units.leftText: both young men and maidens,
units.rightText: young men and maidens,

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD’s name,
units.rightText: Let them praise the name of the LORD,

units.leftText: He has lifted up the horn of his people,
units.rightText: He has raised up a horn for His people,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 149:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
rightNotes: 149:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 9

units.leftText: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them.
units.rightText: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker;

units.leftText: Let them praise his name in the dance!
units.rightText: Let them praise His name with dancing,

units.leftText: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people.
units.rightText: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people;

units.leftText: Let the saints rejoice in honor.
units.rightText: Let the saints exult in glory;

units.leftText: May the high praises of God be in their mouths,
units.rightText: May the high praises of God be in their mouths,

units.leftText: to execute vengeance on the nations,
units.rightText: to inflict vengeance on the nations

units.leftText: to bind their kings with chains,
units.rightText: to bind their kings with chains

units.leftText: to execute on them the written judgment.
units.rightText: to execute the judgment written against them.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Hallelujah!
leftNotes: 150:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
rightNotes: 150:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 6

units.leftText: Praise him for his mighty acts!
units.rightText: Praise Him for His mighty acts;

units.leftText: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet!
units.rightText: Praise Him with the sound of the horn;

units.leftText: Praise him with tambourine and dancing!
units.rightText: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing;

units.leftText: Praise him with loud cymbals!
units.rightText: Praise Him with clashing cymbals;

units.leftText: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!
leftNotes: 150:6 Hebrew: יה Yah
